title: Eyewitness
description: Five years after sending a man to jail Diana returns home to find that he has escaped from prison and has come to confront her.

title: Kidnapped to the Island
description: A star struck teenager is lured to a remote island by a controlling singer who promises her fame and fortune. Her mum, Michelle, must do everything in her power to save her daughter.

title: Love at Sunset Terrace
description: Tired of her fast-paced life, Sophie travels to a seaside town, staying with a father and daughter. As romance stirs, Sophie must make a decision.

title: Killer Caregiver
description: After a woman is injured in an accident, a young and attractive live-in caregiver moves into her home, and some strange and dangerous events unfold.

title: The Baby Proposal
description: Sparks fly between a TV show host and her colleague when they become the unexpected guardians of a baby.

title: Love's Sweet Recipe
description: Sparks fly between a talented chef and her childhood best friend as she regains her passion for cooking.

title: Love You to Death
description: A prosecutor must work on a case which reminds her of her childhood, when her mother was killed by her alcoholic father.

title: Love's Second Chance
description: When Rose inherits her grandmother's vintage dress shop, she runs into her high school crush, Cole, who convinces her to restore the store.

title: @Home With Tori
description:
S01 E04 — Taste of Madrid
Tori Spelling surprises her entire family with a meal that transports them to Spain.

Coreen visits a psychic but is placed in mortal danger when she is possessed by Astaroth. Vicki, Henry and Mike try to save her life and soul.

description: A woman tries to protect her teenage daughter when she becomes the target of anonymous bullies.

description: A young woman named Ana sets out to find someone to help as a means of dealing with her own mother's death, but becomes swept up in a more complicated situation than she anticipated.

description: At a New Year's Eve college party, four women make a vow to call on one another if they're ever in a romantic crisis. Ten years later, they find themselves resurrecting their love club as each searches for eternal happiness.

title: Made For You, With Love
description: The owner of a second hand wedding dress business breathes new life into used dresses, making dreams come true for brides unable to afford pricey gowns. But when she meets the perfect guy, she's afraid to give her own heart a second chance at love.

title: @Home With Tori
description:
S01 E06 — The 90210 Recipe
Tori teams up with Josh Flagg to create a backyard summer camp-out with the Troop Beverly Hills theme.

title: One Last Dance
description: Travis, Chrissa and Max part ways after a dance sequence choreographed by their master Alex goes wrong. Years later, they are forced to reconcile to save the deceased Alex's company.

title: Blood Ties
description:
S01 E01 — Blood Price
An Ex-cop Vicki searches for answers when she witnesses a brutal murder; Henry Fitzroy, a vampire living in Toronto, also decides to look into the murders lest they be blamed on a vampire.

title: Blood Ties
description:
S01 E02 — Blood Price
Vicki is introduced to Henry's world, and the pair battle to stop a demon from being summoned from hell.

title: Blood Ties
description:
S01 E03 — Bad JuJu
When Vicki's client is being hunted by zombies she has to ask Henry for help; Vicki helps a woman locate her missing brother.

title: Blood Ties
description:
S01 E04 — Gifted
Vicki and Henry discover a girl has special powers, while trying to find her estranged father; Mike is on the hunt to find out who Henry is.

title: Blood Ties
description:
S01 E05 — Deadly Departed
The ghost of a convicted killer seeks revenge on the prosecution team that put him behind bars with the help of a witch.

title: Blood Ties
description:
S01 E06 — Love Hurts
A suspicious husband who hires Vicki to prove his wife is unfaithful becomes a prime suspect in his spouse's death.

title: Blood Ties
description:
S01 E07 — Heart of Ice
Vicki investigates missing homeless people; Mike is on another case where a hooker's blood has been drained and Henry is his prime suspect.

title: Blood Ties
description:
S01 E08 — Heart of Fire
Mike must put aside his jealousy and help Vicki save Henry. Henry is being held prisoner by someone from his past.

title: Blood Ties
description:
S01 E09 — Stone Cold
While looking for a missing male model, Vicki and Henry have a run in with Medusa, the Gorgon of Greek lore.

title: Blood Ties
description:
S01 E10 — Necrodome
Vicki is asked to find the dead body of pro boxer Diesel Swanson. Things get weird when a tape shows Diesel getting up and walking out of the funeral home.

title: My Terrorized Teen
description: When her daughter is tormented by the mean girls of her high school, one mother must find a way to put a stop to it before the bullying becomes deadly, but it just might be too late.
